book.name: Luk
book.title: A Wakak a Warwara o e Iesu Karisito e Luk i tumusi

content: E Jon a Tena Baptais i warawai

Ka takai a bonot pa dilima na rau ana matanitu ane Sisar Tiberius, e Pontius Pailat i a tnan ningnigo ana papar Judia, pa e Herot i a ningnigo ana papar Galili, pa e tasnalik e Pilip i a ningnigo ana naur a papar Ituria pa e Trakonitis, pa e Lisanias i a ningnigo ana papar Abilene
pa e Anas pa e Kaiapas dia kibas a titol na ningnigo na tena artabar tetek e God. Ana rau ning, a warwara ane God i hanot tetek e Jon, a nat e Sekaria, ning i kes saot na hanua bel.
Pa i han uting na puknala rop milau ana malum Jodan, i warawai sur a tarai lar lingir a nuknukinla pa dir baptais la, pa e God ir kepsen anunla na toltol laulaula.
Larning di ka tumus tari ana buk anuna propet Aisaia mang,

content.text: “A elngena mainla i arkabah ting na hanua bel mang,
A palisla rop dir por la
pa a pukaleklekla rop pa a mangirla dir kel tostos la.
A ngasla rop ning la ngokngok dir atostos la,
pa a puknala ning la tungtung, dir por tostos la.
Pa a taraila rop lar oroi a titol ane God ning i alaun a tarai ono.’” Ais 40:3-5

content: A kunum a tarai la hanot tetek e Jon sur ir baptais la. Pa i atai la mang, “Ai, mulo na natnat a soila! Esining i atumarang mulo sur mulor liu kumna kusun a warkurai na arkeles ane God ning ir hanot?
Mulor tol a ututnala ning ir apuasa i mang mulo ka lingir a nuknukimulo. Pa gong mulo nuki mang e God bel ir warkurai mulo anasa mulo a mangis a tarai ane Abaram
. A atai mulo, e God i tolsot pasi sur ir tol otnan a mangis a tarai ane Abaram tagun a hatatla ne.
Di ka suah tar a hek ting na kama rakaila, pa rakaila rop ning bel la suah al wakak a wanala, dir ting sen la, pa dir minggen la uting na iah.”
A kunum a tarai la dekeni mang, “Asa ning milar toli?”
I keles la mang, “Esining anuna ir naur a kaen a mermer, ir saran tik tana tik ning bel anuna ta kaen a mermer, mang otleng larning ana utna na hangan.”
Pa dingla na tena los totokom la hanot sur ir baptais la. Pa la dekeni mange, “Tena asaer, asaning milar toli?”
Pa i keles la mange, “Gong mulo kibas totokom i itna tana potopoto ning di ka suah tari.”

Pa dingla na tena harum la dekeni mang, “Pa mila, asaning milar toli?” Pa i keles la mang, “Gong mulo angongos pas a mani kusun a tarai, pa gong mulo artitiu asasongo, mulor gasgas ka ana numulo na arlou.”
A tarai la harnanai sur e Karisito. Ning la longor e Jon, la nuki mang ngandek i a Karisito.

Pa e Jon i atai la rop mang, “A baptais mulo ana malum, ika esaning a rakrakaina i itna tana rakrakaik ir hanot. Pa bel a tolsot pasi sur ar paksen a inau ana anuna su. A natarna kol tana. I ir baptais mulo ana Talngan Tabu pa iah.

I tong pas anuna saol ana naur a kuna sur ir minggen sarara a palpala witla kusun a patnala. Ning ka timlan rop tari, ir suah taum anuna wit ting na rumai a wit, pa ir tun sen a palpalnala ting na iah ning bel i sira mat.”
Ning e Jon i warawai tetek la ana Wakak a Warwara i arakrakai la ana galis a warwara sur lar lingir anunla na toltol.
Pa e Jon i warwara rakrakai tetek e Herot a ningnigo tagun a matanitu, anasa i taulai ulak e Herodias, a hane ane tasnalik, pa i tol otleng a laulau a ututnala.
Pa e Herot i tol ulak a toltol laulau ning i akas e Jon ting na rumai a dodot.
E Jon i baptais e Iesu
Ning e Jon i baptais amon a taraila rop, i baptais otleng e Iesu. Pa ning i nunung, a langit i sapang,
pa a Talngan Tabu i han purum, i suah a palaona lar a tabun, pa i kes saot o e Iesu. Pa a elngena mainla misaot na langit i atongi mang, “U a Natuklik, a katnan u, a gas kol hom.”
A wawas ana mangis a tarai ane Iesu
E Iesu i turpas anuna titol ning ngandek i natol a bonot a rau a lalaun anunai. A tarai la nuki mang i a nat e Josep. E Josep a nat e Heli,
e Heli a nat e Matat, e Matat a nat e Liwai, e Liwai a nat e Melki, e Melki a nat e Janai, e Janai a nat e Josep,
e Josep a nat e Matatias, e Matatias a nat e Amos, e Amos a nat e Nahum, e Nahum a nat e Esli, e Esli a nat e Nagai,
e Nagai a nat e Mat, e Mat a nat e Matatias, e Matatias a nat e Semen, e Semen a nat e Josek, e Josek a nat e Joda,
e Joda a nat e Joanan, e Joanan a nat e Resa, e Resa a nat e Serubabel, e Serubabel a nat e Salatiel, e Salatiel a nat e Neri,
e Neri a nat e Melki, e Melki a nat e Adi, e Adi a nat e Kosam, e Kosam a nat e Elmadam, e Elmadam a nat e Er,
e Er a nat e Josua, e Josua a nat e Elieser, e Elieser a nat e Jorim, e Jorim a nat e Matat, e Matat a nat e Liwai,
e Liwai a nat e Simion, e Simion a nat e Juda, e Juda a nat e Josep, e Josep a nat e Jonam, e Jonam a nat e Eliakim,
e Eliakim a nat e Melea, e Melea a nat e Mena, e Mena a nat e Matata, e Matata a nat e Natan, e Natan a nat e Dewit,
e Dewit a nat e Jesi, e Jesi a nat e Obet, e Obet a nat e Boas, e Boas a nat e Salmon, e Salmon a nat e Nason,
e Nason a nat e Aminadap, e Aminadap a nat e Atmin, e Atmin a nat e Arni, e Arni a nat e Hesron, e Hesron a nat e Peres, e Peres a nat e Juda,
e Juda a nat e Jekop, e Jekop a nat e Aisak, e Aisak a nat e Abaram, e Abaram a nat e Tera, e Tera a nat e Nahor,
e Nahor a nat e Seruk, e Seruk a nat e Reu, e Reu a nat e Pelek, e Pelek a nat e Eber, e Eber a nat e Sela,
e Sela a nat e Kainan, e Kainan a nat e Arpaksat, e Arpaksat a nat e Sem, e Sem a nat e Noa, e Noa a nat e Lamek,
e Lamek a nat e Metusela, e Metusela a nat e Enok, e Enok a nat e Jaret, e Jaret a nat e Mahalalel, e Mahalalel a nat e Kainan,
e Kainan a nat e Enos, e Enos a nat e Set, e Set a nat e Adam, e Adam a nat e God.

footnotes.text: A tarai Israel la nuki mang e God bel ir warkurai la anasa la a mangis a tarai ane Abaram.
